div.p: Anyone can call harvest, which claims any pending dYFI from the gauge and distributes dYFI according to the four way splits.

1. To treasury multisig for future usage
2. To CoveYFI reward forwarder, transferring it to the ERC20RewardsGauge for CoveYFI staking

2. To StakingDelegateRewards: rewarding gauge token depositors.
3. To SwapAndLock: redeems dYFI to YFI and increase veYFI holding
This split can be updated by the accounts with TIMELOCK_ROLE
